one_line: Modern Indian numismatist who re‑ordered the Manikya dynasty coinage of Tripura and challenged traditional chronologies.

appearance.age_look: early 50s, medium height, slightly bookish build
appearance.face: Oval face with a thoughtful, calm expression, light‑brown complexion, thin neatly trimmed moustache, faint smile lines at the eyes, and rectangular metal‑framed spectacles sitting low on the nose; default expression is absorbed, quietly analytical focus.
appearance.hair: Short, neatly combed black hair with light greying at the temples, side‑parted to the left, with a slight wave; no headwear.
appearance.costume: A modest late‑20th‑century Indian scholar’s outfit: long off‑white cotton kurta with a straight hem to mid‑thigh and thin vertical weave texture, over plain light‑grey cotton trousers (pyjama‑style), paired with a dark navy woollen Nehru jacket with three visible buttons and two small pockets, simple brown leather sandals, and a thin analogue wristwatch with a dark strap on the left hand.
appearance.signature: A single worn brown leather‑bound notebook held in the left hand, its pages bristling with tiny paper slips, and a steel fountain pen with a black cap tucked between the pages, symbolising his field notes on Tripura coinage.

ref_desc: N.N. Bhattacharyya is a light‑brown, oval‑faced, bespectacled man in his early fifties with short greying side‑parted black hair, wearing an off‑white kurta, light‑grey trousers, a navy Nehru jacket and brown sandals, always carrying a brown leather notebook with a black‑capped fountain pen.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full‑body anime‑style character model of N.N. Bhattacharyya as a dignified late‑20th‑century Indian numismatist: an early‑50s man of medium height and slightly bookish build, with a light‑brown complexion, oval face, thin neatly trimmed moustache, subtle smile lines, and rectangular metal‑framed spectacles resting low on his nose, his default expression quietly focused and analytical. His hair is short black with gentle greying at the temples, side‑parted to the left with a slight wave, and he wears no headwear. Dress him in an off‑white cotton kurta with a straight hem to mid‑thigh and fine vertical weave texture, over simple light‑grey cotton trousers in a loose pyjama cut, topped by a dark navy woollen Nehru jacket with three buttons and two small pockets. On his feet are plain brown leather sandals, and on his left wrist a thin analogue wristwatch with a dark strap. His signature prop is a worn brown leather‑bound notebook held in his left hand, with small paper slips sticking out and a steel fountain pen with a black cap tucked between the pages, emphasizing his role as a meticulous cataloguer of Tripura’s Manikya dynasty coinage; keep the palette dominated by off‑white, light grey, navy blue, brown and black, and show him front‑facing in a neutral stance, clearly displaying his face, hairstyle, clothing and notebook for consistent replication.
